changelog:
SEO Content Brief v1.0.0

- Initial public release: competitive SEO content brief generator, supporting both new and existing pages.
- Adds robust competitor analysis, gap scoring, and explicit search intent classification.
- Introduces per-section word count and keyword placement/usage guidance.
- Provides templates for multiple page types (blog, service, hub) via new reference files.
- Implements strict filtering of non-competitor SERP domains (see "excluded-domains" reference).
- Detailed internal linking and E-E-A-T trust signal requirements included in every brief.
summary: Generate competitive SEO content briefs with per-section word counts, competitor scoring, keyword density guidance, and page-type templates. Supports both new page briefs and improve-existing-page briefs. Use when user says "content brief", "write a brief", "content outline", "blog brief", "service page brief", "brief for", "writing brief", "content plan", or "outline for".
